title: haageocereus limensis var. zonatus
intro: Haageocereus limensis var. zonatus, commonly known as the Peruvian Apple Cactus, is a species of cactus native to South America, characterized by its striking zebra-like striped pattern on its stem. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The Peruvian Apple Cactus is also reported to have therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Haageocereus limensis var. zonatus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
